title: Pacific TechFronts Lab
text:
Turning data, research, and AI innovation into smarter decisions and measurable impact.
      

      
        Pacific TechFronts Lab is a consulting and innovation lab specializing in data analytics, 
        business intelligence, applied research, artificial intelligence, and professional training. 
        We help organizations transform complex data into actionable intelligence, develop AI-driven solutions, 
        strengthen analytics capabilities, and design evidence-based strategies that accelerate digital transformation and sustainable growth.
Our lab supports organizations across diverse sectors through data analytics consulting, business intelligence, dashboard development, applied research, and AI-driven solutions that enable informed decision-making and sustainable growth.

title: Pacific TechFronts Lab
text:
What We Do

  
    Data Analytics
    We design analytical workflows, predictive models, and decision-support tools that help organizations understand performance, risk, and opportunity.

    We build dashboards, KPI systems, executive reporting tools, and performance-monitoring solutions that turn operational data into clear insight.

    We deliver customized training in analytics, AI, business intelligence, research methods, and digital transformation for teams and leaders.

    to support smarter decision-making.

title: Projects
text:
Smart Food Recovery and Sustainability Dashboard
    
      Partnered with Food Link Society, 
      a local nonprofit focused on reducing food waste and increasing community food security, 
      to design and deploy a modern data dashboard that advances environmental 
      sustainability and social impact.
    
    
      Multi-tab interactive dashboard (Operations, Clients, Data Management) tracking food recovery, distribution, and client impact.
      ETL workflows ingesting FoodMesh and Excel donation records with automated cleaning, aggregation, and visualization.
      Geospatial analysis (maps, company/store tracking) with double-dipping logic to ensure accurate household counts.
      Real-time metrics on food waste diversion, household reach, and volunteer activity to strengthen reporting and grant proposals.
      AI/ML enhancements including demand and supply forecasting, anomaly detection, automated data cleaning, and monthly summary generation.
    
    
      
      
    
  





  
    
    
      AI in Risk Analytics
      
        Two principal theme: (1) AI-Enhanced Credit Scoring- Using mobile usage and social behavior data to unlock access to credit in underbanked regions (MENA). (2) AI for Enhanced Financial Risk Management- Development of a framework to enhance financial risk management in volatile markets. Specifically, we investigate how AI techniques can be effectively integrated to enhance financial risk management with an emphasis on scalability, explainability, and robustness in real-world applications.  
        Goal: Inclusive, explainable AI for financial inclusion.
      
    
  


  
  
    
    
       Creative Destruction Lab Venture Accelerator Program Dashboard
      
        Developing a predictive analytics dashboard to model and visualize venture success through machine learning and Statistical techniques to inform business and investment decisions. The dash app visualizes venture data and success indicators using an interactive Dash-based interface.  
      
    
  

 

  
    
  
  
    Trader’s Copilot: Trading Signals for Stock Markets
    
      Python package for ARIMA, Prophet, and LSTM-based financial forecasting with visual diagnostics.  
    
  


  

  
    
  
  
    Vehicle Dashboard
    
      Real-time dashboard for Canadian car market analysis using Dash. Includes insights on price and performance trends.
    
  


  
  
    
    
      Innovation, Sustainability and Technological Megatrends 
      
        The project explores how emerging technologies intersect with sustainability, economic resilience, and regulatory adaptation amidst global instability. 
        Goal: Illuminate how technological megatrends can be harnessed to support sustainable development, accountability, and resilient innovation strategies.
      
    
  



 

  
  
    AI Decision-Making Systems and Algorithmic Futures 
    
      The project explores six main themes:  
      (1) the evolution of the algorithm economy and its transformative role in governance, industry, finance, labor, and society;  
      (2) Algorithmic decision-making systems including reinforcement learning for policy optimization and resource allocation;  
      (3) Bayesian decision theory in high-stakes environments (e.g., healthcare, finance);  
      (4) Data-centric AI and algorithmic infrastructure;  
      (5) Algorithmic bias, fairness, and social impact modeling, along with responsible AI and secure deployment; and  
      (6) E-waste: allocative efficiency in the algorithmic economy.
      Part of the
      
        GUS Fellowship Program
      .
